user.title: GlowCast
user.description: Sync existing Home Assistant lights into themed animated shows. Rooms are auto-created from areas that contain lights.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single GlowCast configuration is allowed.

general.title: GlowCast general options
general.description: Exclude lights, mark slow (Bluetooth) lights, tune rate limits, and set Team Colors.

start_theme.name: Start theme
start_theme.description: Start a themed show for a room.

room.name: Room
room.description: Room id (area id, all_lights, or custom group id).

theme.name: Theme
theme.description: Optional theme key; sets Manual mode.

stop.name: Stop show
stop.description: Stop the show for a room (or all rooms) and restore prior light states.

room.name: Room
room.description: Optional room id. Omit to stop all.

set_color.name: Set color
set_color.description: Set a solid color for a room (or all_lights). Snapshots and starts from idle; hot-swaps into a static custom_color effect while a show is running. Switches mode to manual. Stop or turn off the show switch to restore prior light states.

room.name: Room
room.description: Room id (area id, all_lights, or custom group id). Optional if a GlowCast entity or device is targeted.

rgb_color.name: RGB color
rgb_color.description: Required RGB color as [R, G, B] (0-255 each).

brightness.name: Brightness
brightness.description: Optional brightness 0-100. Defaults to the room brightness number.
